title: Travel Rule Sunrise Jurisdiction Matrix
description: Looks up an origin/destination jurisdiction pair for crypto Travel Rule corridor status (both-live, one-sided sunrise, neither-live, or self-hosted-wallet out-of-scope), with thresholds, required originator/beneficiary fields, and the enforcement-gap flag from the FATF 16 Jul 2026 Seventh Targeted Update. Client-side. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: lookup_travel_rule_corridor_status
mcp_tool_definition.description: Looks up an origin/destination jurisdiction pair for crypto Travel Rule corridor status using an editable reference set keyed to the FATF Seventh Targeted Update (16 Jul 2026: 83 percent of 109 surveyed jurisdictions have legislation in force, 11 in progress, 60 percent of in-force jurisdictions have zero enforcement action; Argentina, Cambodia, Colombia, and Vietnam are named as having no framework). Reports BOTH-LIVE / ONE-SIDED sunrise asymmetry / NEITHER-LIVE / OUT-OF-SCOPE (self-hosted wallet counterparty) verdicts, applies each leg's numeric threshold (EU TFR zero-threshold since 30 Dec 2024 with self-hosted ownership verification above EUR 1,000) to the entered amount to select a full vs reduced required-field tier, and surfaces the enforcement-gap flag beside legislation status. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/640-travel-rule-sunrise-matrix.html for interactive use.
